domain_specific_rationale: From an Inter-Service Contract and Idempotency perspective, CP-019 ensures schema symmetry between GenerationJob and ProviderRequest by adding attempt_index (integer >= 1, default: 1) to the required property list in provider-request.schema.json. Provider adapters require the attempt_index to compute distinct provider-side idempotency keys for consecutive retry attempts while guaranteeing deterministic deduplication for duplicate invocations of the same attempt. This eliminates contract mismatch between core orchestration and provider SDKs.
capability_impact: Preserves CAP-03 (Provider Abstraction) and CAP-12 (Autonomous Error Recovery).
residual_risk: Callers failing to supply attempt_index will be rejected by JSON schema validation. Mitigated by specifying default: 1 and verifying request generation in workflow orchestrator unit tests.
